engine: Saisei's interstitial loader — a centred brand monogram (木 / a logo glyph) fades in, a thin SVG ring strokes ON around it (stroke-dashoffset full->0, started ~7 o'clock), and the next page's grid skeleton (vertical column rules) strokes in top->down. NOT a timed flourish — a real NETWORK-WAIT GATE: holds for a min time AND until the page signals ready, then retracts. Harvested from D_saisei (S2 + S3 grid-skeleton).

measured_teardown.move: show() builds the loader (monogram fade ~250ms, ring stroke-on ~500ms from 7 o'clock, vertical grid rules scaleY 0->1 top-down, staggered). It HOLDS until BOTH minHold elapsed AND ready() called, then hide() retracts (ring un-draws, rules recede bottom-up, monogram fades, root fades).
measured_teardown.cited: Saisei page transition v2 f071-099 / v3 f011-036: 木 + ring + grid rules on cream, held across the real load (URL changes mid-hold, tab spinner active), then retracts as the new page opens.

glyph.what: monogram text (or pass markup via opts.html).

grid.what: vertical rule positions (% of width) = the next page's column skeleton; [] = no skeleton.

minHold.what: guaranteed minimum on-screen time before hide can run.

entry: MonogramRingLoader.create(target, opts) -> { el, show(), ready(), hide(), whenDone(cb), destroy }. show() animates it in. ready() signals the page loaded — hide() then runs once BOTH minHold elapsed AND ready. whenDone(cb) fires after the out animation (chain the page open here). destroy() removes it.
law: opacity + SVG stroke-dashoffset + transform(scaleY) only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant in/out. GSAP optional (built-in rAF power3 tween fallback). owns_pin false. THE CONTRACT: min-hold + resolve-when-ready, NEVER a hardcoded ms — else the skeleton-draw desyncs from real content readiness.
gate_mode: triggered overlay (not scroll-driven), SVG/DOM media (no ) — the wheel-scroll smoothness-gate does not apply. Verify in the combo (lab-full): the loader holds on cream then retracts, fps>=50, jank<8%.
proven: lab-full (combo with center-seam-split + mask-up-title + content-stage-cascade) on OUR QUADRO: after the cream close, the 木 monogram + stroking ring + 3 grid rules hold on the cream gap (minHold 900ms), ready() at ~1100ms, then retract and chain the dark open. Full 4-brick transition smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle): 1/311 long frames (0.3%), 59.9fps.
